_meta.description: Listing status definitions, valid transitions, DOM rules, and timing enforcement. Machine-readable status state machine.
_meta.source: UCBA 2026 Art. I + memory/REBNY-MASTER.md Sections A, J

ComingSoon.displayBadge: Coming Soon. No Showings or Open House until [Start Showing Date]
restrictions: One-time use per address/owner unless off-market 60+ days

Closed.sla: Must update within 24 hours of closing
Closed.websiteRule: Must remove or mark closed on broker website within 24 hours

restrictions: ALL fields blocked from ALL channels
No RLS, no IDX, no VOW, no Syndication, no public
OwnerOptOut.exception: 1:1 personal phone calls and emails to Participants
rules: Must be set at creation — cannot transition into this state
OwnerOptOut.requiredForm: Owner Opt-Out Form (Exhibit B) within 48 hours

restrictions: No IDX, VOW, Syndication, websites, social media

invalidTransitions.reason: Closed is terminal — no transitions allowed
Must be set at creation, not transitioned into

domRules.startsAt: RLS submission timestamp (not listing contract date)
domRules.resetTrigger: 30 consecutive days in Withdrawn or Cancelled
domRules.circumventionBlocked: Cannot circumvent DOM by re-naming or re-listing same address/unit within 30 days

timingEnforcement.alert: If CloseDate set but no ClosePrice
Alert at day 12, force status change at day 14
